3.4.summary: All 55 live /solar-savings/[city] pages re-scoped to who supplies the power and what it costs (URLs kept): delivering utility and generation provider (CEC load-serving layers queried at each city point 2026-09-24, cross-checked with CCA member lists and site data), CPUC PAO average rate, D.24-05-028 fixed charge (4.15/2.08/.00), published plan names (PG&E, SCE, SDG&E, SMUD), SCE baseline region and allowances for 18 SCE cities, CARE/FERA and net billing in one short section, links to the companies and cost pages; a Sources list on every page (45 [city] pages had none). Removed: RelatedInstallers, TrustedSources, LBNL price benchmark, HOA, tax credit, sun-hours, when-solar-does-not-work, older FAQs. The city's sourced bill copy from growth-cities.ts moved from the companies page to the savings page (34 cities). Titles/H1s name the provider(s).
3.4.not_done: The 6 regional hubs (/solar-savings/bay-area, central-valley, inland-empire, los-angeles-county, orange-county, san-diego-county) are part of the audit's 51 without a sources list; they cite sources inline and were not edited (see requests). 36 of 55 pages still fail the sibling gate (see 3.5).

3.5.summary: Companies: 139 of 140 pass (>= 3 named local data points and max sibling overlap < 0.5); only /solar-companies/rancho-cordova fails (0.549, its table is the Sacramento County fallback shared with /solar-companies/elk-grove). Savings: 19 of 55 pass; cities that share a utility and CCA have the same answer, so their pages overlap (0.50-0.90).
3.5.method: Rendered HTML (esbuild bundle of the two [city] routes, React renderToStaticMarkup; scripts in _gs_manifest/citycos_measure). Prose = text blocks inside <main> (p, li, h1-h4, td, th, dt, dd), skipping form, nav, aside, script, style and data-toc-ignore blocks (inquiry form, bill tool). Lowercase word tokens; 8-word shingles within each block. Overlap = share of the page's shingles also on a sibling (containment, the audit's definition), max over all live pages of the same family; Jaccard with that sibling also reported. Named local data points: companies = key facts + installer table + DG metrics shown (2025 count, lease/PPA share, battery share, median size, 2021-2025 trend); savings = delivering utility (2 for a split city), generation provider, SCE baseline region, the city's moved bill paragraph and bill sections, or the bills page's own sections.
